meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: 把用户给的网址抓取下来,转成带标题、网址等元信息的 Markdown 文件并保存。能渲染动态网页,需要登录的页面可先等用户准备好再抓取。
howto.when: 当用户想把某个网页保存成 Markdown 时触发,通常在给出链接并要求转换为 md 时。

say.text: 把这个网页保存成 Markdown:https://example.com
say.note: 直接抓取并转成 md 文件。

say.text: 用等待模式抓取这个需要登录的页面:https://example.com
say.note: 脚本会等你示意页面准备好再抓取。

howto.what_en: Takes a URL from the user, opens it in Chrome, and converts the page into a Markdown file with YAML metadata (url, title, description, author, etc.). Supports auto-capture on page load and wait-for-user mode for login-required pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a webpage as Markdown, typically when they provide a URL and ask for conversion.

say_en.text: Save this webpage as Markdown: https://example.com
say_en.note: It fetches and converts the page directly.

say_en.text: Use wait mode for this login-required page: https://example.com
say_en.note: It waits until you confirm the page is ready.

say_en.text: Convert https://example.com to Markdown and save as output.md
say_en.note: The file is saved to the specified path.
